windows.signCommand: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { $bundlePath = '%1'; $scriptCandidates = @('./src-tauri/scripts/sign-windows.ps1', './scripts/sign-windows.ps1'); foreach ($script in $scriptCandidates) { if (Test-Path $script) { & $script $bundlePath; exit $LASTEXITCODE } } throw 'Windows signing script not found.' }"
